svg.text: Fig. 7 — Light hydrogen in 3-D, at the atom's scale and at the particles' scale
left: 1s cloud (sampled from |ψ|²) with the 21 cm spin-current loops round the proton; right: the electron's double loop of light and the proton ring, true relative size
proton ring, 0.21 fm (a dot at this scale)
electron: light twice round a ring of 193 fm (H23)
the whole right panel is 0.006 a0 wide: a point in the left panel
